title: Parole Intrecciate per Anziani e Ipovedenti
english: Large Print Word Search for Seniors & Low Vision
tagline: 90 extra-large, high-contrast word search grids celebrating Italian culture.
description: Our most accessible Italian word search book, designed for seniors and readers living with macular degeneration (AMD) or other visual difficulties. Every grid is printed in extra-large letters with strong contrast, so the eyes can relax while the mind stays busy.

Each puzzle is built around keywords from Italian tradition: cities, monuments, flavours, melodies, scientific discoveries, animals and landscapes. A lovely starting point for memories and conversations with the grandchildren.
features: 90 grids and more than 1,500 words to find
Three levels: Easy, Medium and Difficult
XL letters and high contrast for low vision

title: Parole Intrecciate per Anziani e Adulti
english: Italian Word Search for Seniors & Adults
tagline: A relaxing word search journey through Italy's landmarks, cuisine and culture.
description: A word search adventure across Italy for seniors and adults. Each chapter opens with a short introduction to its theme, then invites you to hunt for the famous places, dishes and traditions that make Italy unique.
Clear, generous grids make it a comfortable daily companion, perfect for a quiet afternoon or a coffee break.

title: Giochi di Memoria per Anziani
tagline: Seven kinds of brain games in one book: word searches, crosswords, anagrams, sudoku and more.
description: A complete brain-training workout in Italian. Instead of one puzzle type, this book mixes seven different activities so every session feels fresh and works a different part of the memory.
The puzzles explore Italian fashion, mythology, history and culture, with easy, medium and harder levels so readers can progress at their own pace.
features: Word search, crosswords, anagrams and word matching

title: Giochi di Memoria per Anziani Intelligenti
tagline: Brain games that connect the traditions of the past with the vocabulary of today.
description: Designed for curious minds who love a challenge. The puzzles move between traditional and modern vocabulary, from classic Italian culture to the words of the digital age.
Mixing word searches, crosswords, cryptograms with famous quotes, word scrambles and mazes, it keeps memory, attention and logic in good shape.

title: Viaggio per l'Italia: Edizione Esercizi Variati
english: A Journey Through Italy: Mixed Puzzles Edition
tagline: Crosswords, matching games, cryptograms and sudoku that map Italy's cultural heritage.
description: An activity book that turns a trip around Italy into a series of varied puzzles. From crosswords to matching games, from cryptograms to sudoku, each activity guides you through a different region and theme.
Exercises come in three levels (easy, medium and difficult), so beginners and experienced solvers both find the right challenge.
features: Discover Italian regions and hidden treasures

title: Viaggio per l'Italia: Libro di Attività
english: A Journey Through Italy: Activity Book
tagline: Crosswords and puzzles about Italy's iconic monuments, history and mysteries.
description: Pack your pencil and travel across Italy! This activity book combines crosswords and other puzzles about iconic monuments, little-known historical details and the mysteries of Sicily.
A cheerful, colourful gift for anyone who loves Italy, with puzzles organised by level for steady, enjoyable progress.
features: Great gift for lovers of Italy

title: Cruciverba per Anziani e Adulti
tagline: Italian crosswords about monuments, history, art, folklore and music.
description: Classic Italian crosswords for seniors and adults who enjoy culture and history. The clues take you through the great monuments, the stories of Italy, its art, folklore and music.
Clear grids and well-spaced clues make each crossword a pleasure to complete, one square at a time.
features: Culture and history in every puzzle

title: Cruciverba per Nonni
tagline: Crosswords for grandparents, with a fun fact after every puzzle.
description: Made with grandparents in mind: themed Italian crosswords about history, cooking, nature, geography, music and art. After each crossword a short fun fact adds something new to talk about.
A thoughtful gift for nonna and nonno, and a good excuse to solve a puzzle together with the grandchildren.
features: A fun fact after each puzzle

title: Mots Croisés pour Seniors et Malvoyants
english: Large Print French Crosswords for Seniors & Low Vision
tagline: Large print French crosswords from French heritage to Francophone festivals.
description: A crossword book made with care for grandparents and lovers of the French language. Large fonts and high contrast keep the eyes comfortable, and the large pages are easy to handle.
The clues travel from French castles and cheeses to Francophone capitals and festivals, with three difficulty levels (one to three stars).
features: Three levels: one star (easy) to three stars (expert)
Large pages that are easy to handle
A short fun fact with the puzzles

title: Mots Mêlés pour Seniors et Malvoyants
english: Large Print French Word Search for Seniors & Low Vision
tagline: 14 themes of large print French word searches, from French heritage to cinema.
description: For everyone who wants to keep their mind sharp while going easy on their eyes. Every grid uses large letters, high contrast and an airy layout.
Fourteen themes cover French heritage, food, music, nature and cinema, in three difficulty levels. It works just as well alone as with a partner, friends or grandchildren.
features: Large print, high contrast and an airy layout

title: Mots Mêlés Malvoyants
english: Large Print French Word Search for Low Vision
tagline: Large print French word searches about natural wonders, world festivals and history.
description: A large print French word search book designed for readers with low vision. The bold, well-spaced grids are easy to scan, and every word list is printed large.
The themes travel the world: everyday technology, natural wonders, world festivals and celebrations, history and capital cities.
